Ryūzaburō Ōtomo (Japanese: 大友龍三郎 Ōtomo Ryūzaburō) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Ōtomo was born on May 18, 1952, in , . As an adult, he became a voice actor and led a long voice acting career since the mid-1970s. For , Ōtomo initially voiced Muramasa, a character of the day who appeared in ; and , nicknamed Bruteroot, in the first movie. He then voiced Snowbelle City Gym Leader Wulfric during . He has affiliations with the talent agencies and , as well as the .
